answer: Make every new identity solve a sequential verifiable delay before it can trade, timed by a quartz-steady clock the network all agrees on: one delay per identity, impossible to parallelize, so a farm minting a thousand fakes must wait a thousand delays while a single honest sparrow waits once. The mesa of cost is flat for the honest and a mountain for the attacker, because each fake identity burns the same wall-clock time and the delay receipt is checked before any payment clears.
